speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; tell me, how many days old are you exactly, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus.

The history of bilious vomiting within six hours of birth in a term infant is a surgical emergency until proven otherwise. Please proceed immediately to the operating room for exploratory laparotomy.
